config.cutoff_policy: 00:00 America/New_York on the first scheduled date of the checkpoint week
config.ties: Known ties fixed; future ties not simulated
config.postseason: Actual postseason field is used for labels only; never for simulation
config.schedule: Reconstructed final historical fixtures; not an archived schedule vintage

note: Retrospective development audit on reconstructed final schedules. Elo only; QB/advanced corrections are not evaluated here. Uses result-based NFL tiebreakers through strength of schedule. Ties still unresolved are randomized; points and touchdowns are not simulated. Future ties are not simulated. These are model estimates, not official clinching odds.

uncertainty.note: Whole seasons resampled; teams and checkpoints within a season remain together. Few season blocks; Monte Carlo error is not included.
